scope: Source-backed draft launch entry points for formation, tax registration and permits. Process browsing only; no added vendor availability or startup simulation entity support.

countries.label: Netherlands

formation.guidance: Choose the appropriate legal structure and registration route using KVK and the Dutch government startup checklist. Confirm residence, business address and any notarial work for the selected entity before authorizing registration.

tax.guidance: Reconcile the KVK registration and tax-administration records, including any identifiers issued through formation. Confirm which registrations still need action for the entity and its activities; the company register and tax obligations are distinct.

permits.guidance: Check the activity, profession and premises against sector, municipal and environment/planning permissions. Use the relevant authority route and keep restricted activities paused until required approvals are confirmed.

knownGaps: Entity-specific notarial documents and tax determinations need local review.
Immigration, employment, pensions, sector authorizations and municipal procedures are not fully authored here.

countries.label: Ireland

formation.guidance: Select the company type and review the CRO registration methods, required steps and post-registration obligations. Use the company-specific officer, constitution and registered-office requirements rather than transplanting US formation documents.

tax.guidance: Review Revenue registration for the actual company and tax heads. Confirm the CRO number, tax representation and appropriate ROS or form route before submitting; incorporation alone does not settle all tax registration.

permits.guidance: Use the Irish Point of Single Contact to identify competent authorities and licensing procedures for the proposed services. Obtain activity-specific advice for work outside the portal scope and track outstanding permissions separately from CRO registration.

knownGaps: Detailed company forms, employer obligations and VAT positions need case-specific review.
The services portal does not establish complete sector, immigration or premises coverage.

countries.label: Spain

formation.guidance: Choose the legal form and check whether CIRCE supports its formation and startup procedures. Coordinate any required registry, notarial and social-security work for that form rather than assuming every company follows the same online path.

tax.guidance: Use Agencia Tributaria census guidance to confirm NIF assignment and the applicable business census declarations. Review the entity facts and representation before filing; retain confirmation of actual registration rather than relying on an application draft.

permits.guidance: Identify the national, autonomous-community and municipal authorities responsible for the specific activity and location. Confirm the applicable authorization or notification route and retain its evidence before starting restricted operations.

knownGaps: Autonomous-community and municipal procedures require local checking.
Employment, immigration, tax calculations and sector-specific rules remain separate reviewed workstreams.

countries.label: Sweden

formation.guidance: Select the business form and follow the corresponding Verksamt registration route. For a limited company, coordinate company registration with the separate tax and employer registrations relevant to the intended operations.

tax.guidance: Use Skatteverket startup registration guidance to assess F-tax, VAT and employer registration for the selected business. Verify the register extract and outstanding applications; do not assume one approval covers every tax role.

permits.guidance: Search Verksamt by industry, regulated profession and competent authority. Check county and municipality requirements for the premises and activities, and keep any unresolved permit conditions assigned to an owner.

knownGaps: The limited-company reference does not describe all legal forms.
Employment agreements, social contributions and local sector procedures need their own review.

countries.label: Switzerland

formation.guidance: Choose the legal form and relevant cantonal commercial-register route. SECO describes EasyGov preparation and registration support; arrange any required notarial certification rather than treating an online draft as a formed company.

tax.guidance: Confirm the commercial-register and UID record, then separately assess registration with the Federal Tax Administration for VAT. The VAT service describes required company and representative evidence; it does not determine every federal and cantonal tax obligation.

permits.guidance: Use SECO startup guidance to identify regulated activities and the responsible federal or cantonal authority. Verify the relevant professional or activity authorization before operating; a commercial-register entry is not evidence of sector permission.

knownGaps: Cantonal taxes and regulatory procedures differ and need local review.
Immigration, social insurance, employment and regulated-profession approvals are not fully authored here.

countries.label: Japan

formation.guidance: Use JETRO to select the form of entry and map registration, office, tax-notice and personnel work. Have qualified local owners confirm the entity-specific documents and any investment notifications before the authorized registration.

tax.guidance: Use National Tax Agency corporation-establishment guidance to identify the relevant tax notices and salary-office registration work. Confirm the entity and local-tax requirements with an adviser; English reference forms do not establish completed filing or every applicable obligation.

permits.guidance: JETRO separates business establishment from business-related licences and permits. Identify the competent activity authority and permissions for the actual product or service before launch; local registration alone does not authorize a regulated activity.

knownGaps: Investment notifications, immigration, local taxes and sector permissions require specialist determination.
English reference material may not cover every current form or local procedure.

countries.label: Brazil

formation.guidance: Use the official CNPJ service and REDESIM integration for the entity registration and legalization route. Confirm the legal form, competent registering body and local integration rather than assuming one company type or municipality procedure.

tax.guidance: Confirm CNPJ registration and reconcile it with the entity record. Have the responsible accountant identify additional state, municipal and tax-regime registrations for the actual activities; a CNPJ alone is not a completed tax-compliance setup.

permits.guidance: Use REDESIM licensing guidance and the relevant local integrator to identify activity and location permissions. Track each authority decision and do not treat the CNPJ issuance itself as proof that restricted operations may start.

knownGaps: State and municipal registrations and licensing vary by activity and location.
Tax-regime selection, payroll and sector-specific approvals need qualified Brazilian review.

countries.label: United Arab Emirates

formation.guidance: Select the emirate and mainland or specific free-zone route first. The linked federal guide describes mainland steps; obtain the chosen free-zone authority procedure separately rather than applying mainland steps or Dubai examples nationwide.

tax.guidance: Review Federal Tax Authority corporate-tax registration for the specific person and entity structure. Confirm applicable registration and deadlines with an adviser, and assess VAT separately; free-zone status does not establish a blanket tax exemption.

permits.guidance: Identify the competent emirate economic department or free-zone authority and the approved business activity. Confirm additional activity permissions and the issued licence scope before starting work; a mainland checklist does not authorize a free-zone operation.

knownGaps: Free-zone and emirate-specific procedures require the actual authority guidance.
Immigration, employment, VAT treatment and regulated activity permissions need separate local review.
